comments.author: cletus
comments.why: Example of one man moving huge stones without machinery.
comments.text: Ngl, I saw the title and thought it was going to be about the overheard of the JVM. The common view of how hard it is to move large stones doesn't match reality. There are many examples (eg [1][2]) of what one man can do without any heavy machinery. People have been moving large stones around for thousands of years. And the "how" is simply using leverage and the power of many people and beasts of burden. Still, it's interesting that they would. I suspect many of them didn't have a choice. comments.author: agumonkey
comments.story: The growing body of evidence that digital distraction is damaging our minds
comments.why: Levers and gears let one person move tons.
comments.text: It's a bit of wild speculation but you don't need industry to save you time. Solar concentrator (lens, mirror) can harvest large amount of energy. Proper use of levers and gears can make you move tons with your fingers (although you need experience), see [VIDEO] and the likes You don't need to reproduce horse plow with an oil based engine.
